correctness.rationale: The determinant polarization and p^{3j} smooth reduction are exact over every odd prime-power residue ring; the normal form for primitive nonunits gives the unit factorization count. Unit-target fibers reduce to a complete trace/determinant count with exact p-adic square-root multiplicities. Sharp minimal count and equality multiplicity follow from a complete partition of all target matrices by entry content and residue determinant. Exact integer checks of full small cases and sampled larger cases reproduce the formula. Computation is corroboration only.

value.rationale: The theorem supplies a complete exact local-ring convolution on a canonical determinant-one matrix hypersurface for all odd primes and depths, not an arbitrary finite slice. It isolates singular discriminant effects and gives an optimal pointwise mixing minorization uniform in depth, together with exact equality multiplicity; both are natural global invariants for the additive Cayley walk.
